en.tagline: Copy reusable Remotion video components into a project
en.summary: Elements are reusable video components, such as titles, backgrounds, charts and caption styles. This skill copies an Element's source code into a Remotion project with `npx remotion elements use`, so the project owns an editable copy. It also adds Element libraries to Remotion Studio.
problem: A video often needs a title, background, chart or caption style. Building each one from scratch takes time, and Element pages and libraries offer ready-made versions, but placing one correctly means checking files, packages and assets.
With this skill, the agent runs a dry run first, then copies the Element into the composition's folder and inserts it at frame 0. The user then changes the text, colors and timing to fit the video.
fit: Adding a ready-made title, background, chart or caption style
Starting from an Element page URL or an Element library URL
Listing an Element library in Remotion Studio so its Elements can be previewed
unfit: A project with no Remotion setup yet, which needs the remotion-create skill first
Elements from sources the user does not trust, because their code runs in the project
steps: Get the Element page URL from the user, or pick one from an Element library's Markdown index.
If the Element comes from a library, run `npx remotion elements add-library <library-url>` to list that library in Remotion Studio.
Run `npx remotion elements use <element-page-url> --composition <composition-id> --dry-run` and fix any errors it reports.
Run the same command with `--yes` to add missing packages, save assets to `public/`, write an `.element.tsx` file and insert the Element at frame 0.
Adapt the text, colors and props, and adjust the wrapping `<Sequence>` for timing.
Open the composition in Remotion Studio and check that the Element renders.

zh.tagline: 把可复用的视频组件复制进 Remotion 项目
zh.summary: Element 是可复用的视频组件，例如标题、背景、图表和字幕样式。这个技能通过 `npx remotion elements use` 把 Element 的源代码复制进 Remotion 项目，项目中得到的是一份可以自由修改的副本。它还能把 Element 库添加到 Remotion Studio 中。
problem: 做视频时常常需要标题、背景、图表或字幕样式。从零开始做每一个都很费时间。Element 页面和 Element 库提供了现成的组件，但要放对位置，还得检查文件、依赖包和素材。
使用这个技能时，代理会先做一次试运行，然后把 Element 复制到合成所在的文件夹，并在第 0 帧插入。之后用户再按视频需要修改文字、颜色和时间。
fit: 添加现成的标题、背景、图表或字幕样式
手上有 Element 页面网址或 Element 库网址
在 Remotion Studio 中列出 Element 库，以便预览其中的 Element
unfit: 项目还没有 Remotion 环境，需要先使用 remotion-create 技能
来源不可信的 Element，因为它的代码会在项目中运行
steps: 向用户获取 Element 页面网址，或从 Element 库的 Markdown 索引中选一个。
如果 Element 来自某个库，运行 `npx remotion elements add-library <library-url>`，把该库列在 Remotion Studio 中。
运行 `npx remotion elements use <element-page-url> --composition <composition-id> --dry-run`，并修复它报告的错误。
加上 `--yes` 运行同一条命令，补齐缺少的依赖包，把素材保存到 `public/`，写入一个 `.element.tsx` 文件，并在第 0 帧插入 Element。
调整文字、颜色和属性，并修改外层 `<Sequence>` 的时间和位置。
在 Remotion Studio 中打开该合成，确认 Element 能正常渲染。
